attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, published under his name. The aside is his comment, not a quote of the X thread or of Davis.

semantics.note: The normalisation keeps the 'not even clear' hedge and the comparison with the 2017 techniques, and correctly reads 'this' as inferring geography from text. It is a statement of uncertainty, not a firm claim that LLMs do no better.

contract.note: The contract rightly declines to set binary conditions. Marcus names no metric, comparison method, or standard for 'clear'. Any scoring would need definitions he did not give.

evidence.note: The Gurnee & Tegmark v1 abstract (2023-10-03) identifies the work Marcus was discussing. It contains no comparison with the 2017 techniques, so it neither supports nor contradicts the claim.

reviews.rationale: 'Not even clear' only says he is uncertain how LLMs compare with older techniques. It gives no measure or threshold, so it is hedged language that policy does not score. The only evidence item is context. The case is intact, so this is a not_adjudicable outcome rather than an abstention.
